cases.question: What will the U.S. seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) of total privately-owned housing starts be for July 2026, in thousands of units?

metadata.title: What will the U.S. seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) of total privately-owned housing starts be for July 2026, in thousands of units?
metadata.criteria: This question resolves to the preliminary U.S. seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) of total privately-owned housing starts for July 2026, expressed in thousands of units, as reported in the U.S. Census Bureau New Residential Construction press release scheduled for August 18, 2026. Use the value as initially published, not any later revision.
metadata.fine_print: If the release is delayed, use the first official Census Bureau release provided it is published on or before September 9, 2026. Otherwise use credible sources attributing the data to the Census Bureau, or resolve N/A.

cases.question: What will SpaceX's closing market capitalization be on its first day of trading as a public company?

metadata.title: What will SpaceX's closing market capitalization be on its first day of trading as a public company?
metadata.criteria: This question resolves to the bucket containing SpaceX's market capitalization at the official closing price of its first day of trading as a public company on a major U.S. stock exchange (Nasdaq or NYSE), where market capitalization equals fully diluted shares outstanding (as disclosed in SpaceX's final prospectus or registration statement filed with the SEC) multiplied by the closing share price on that first trading day. The first trading day must occur on or after May 19, 2026 and on or before September 9, 2026. The closing price will be taken from the listing exchange's official closing print as reported by Nasdaq/NYSE or, if unavailable, from credible sources. If a value falls exactly on a bucket boundary, it resolves to the higher bucket. If SpaceX has not begun trading on a major U.S. stock exchange by the close of trading on September 9, 2026, the question resolves to "No IPO before September 10, 2026."
metadata.fine_print: Begin trading means regular-way trading commences on Nasdaq or NYSE following an IPO or direct listing; a SPAC merger or reverse merger involving SpaceX also qualifies. If first-day trading is halted or no official closing price is published on the first day, the next trading day with an official closing print will be used as the first trading day for resolution purposes. If SpaceX's final prospectus does not clearly disclose fully diluted shares outstanding, basic shares outstanding as of the closing of the IPO will be used.

cases.question: What will be the outcome of Duane "Keffe D" Davis's Tupac Shakur murder trial by September 11, 2026?

metadata.title: What will be the outcome of Duane "Keffe D" Davis's Tupac Shakur murder trial by September 11, 2026?
options: Guilty of a lesser homicide offense
Mistrial, or no verdict yet reached
metadata.criteria: This question concerns the criminal trial of Duane Keffe D Davis in Clark County District Court, Nevada, on the charge of first-degree murder (with a deadly weapon and gang enhancement) in the 1996 killing of Tupac Shakur. Jury selection began August 10, 2026. The question resolves based on the trial's status as of 23:59 US Pacific Time on September 10, 2026, according to reporting from the Associated Press or other credible sources. It resolves to the option describing the jury's verdict if one has been returned: Guilty of first-degree murder if the jury convicts Davis of first-degree murder (regardless of the enhancement findings); Guilty of a lesser homicide offense if the jury acquits on first-degree murder but convicts on a lesser included homicide offense; Not guilty (full acquittal) if the jury acquits Davis on all homicide charges submitted to it. It resolves Mistrial, or no verdict yet reached if the court has declared a mistrial or if the jury has not returned any verdict by the resolution date, including a guilty plea or dismissal.
metadata.fine_print: If Davis dies before a verdict is returned, the question resolves Mistrial, or no verdict yet reached. A conviction on first-degree murder resolves Guilty of first-degree murder even if sentencing or enhancement determinations remain pending.

cases.question: What will be the water level of the Rhine river, according to the Kaub gauging station, on September 1, 2026?

metadata.title: What will be the water level of the Rhine river, according to the Kaub gauging station, on September 1, 2026?

cases.question: What percentage of all startup or tech company job openings will be with Amazon on September 2, 2026?

metadata.criteria: This question resolves as the percentage, rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent, of all job openings at top startups and big tech companies that are at Amazon, displayed by TrueUp's Big Tech Hiring tracker when accessed by Metaculus on or after September 2, 2026. Numerator: Open jobs at Amazon. Denominator: open jobs at top startups and big tech companies on the same page.

cases.question: When will a publicly-available LLM achieve gold on the International Math Olympiad?

metadata.title: When will a publicly-available LLM achieve gold on the International Math Olympiad?
metadata.criteria: This question will resolve to the date when it is publicly announced that a general large language model system available to the public scores gold in the International Math Olympiad. If this does not happen before January 1, 2030, resolves as Not less than or equal to January 1, 2030. The model must be domain-general, publicly queryable by browser or API, and need not be open-weights. Gold threshold must be achieved on an IMO and announced by credible sources. Problems must be provided in natural language and images as applicable. Internet search during problem-solving is not allowed.

cases.question: When will the world create the first Trillionaire?

metadata.title: When will the world create the first Trillionaire?
metadata.criteria: This question resolves as the first date any person is ranked on Forbes Billionaires List with net worth of at least $1,000 billion in nominal USD. If this does not occur before January 1, 2075, resolves ambiguous. If Forbes list ceases, other credible multiply-sourced estimates may be accepted.

cases.question: When Will an AI be Amongst the Best Forecasters on Metaculus

metadata.title: When Will an AI be Amongst the Best Forecasters on Metaculus
metadata.criteria: Credible reporting that one of the top 10 accounts on the one-year duration peer accuracy leaderboard is a bot, with at least 25 in the questions column. Credibility is subjectively judged by the author. The account need not be completely automated if its entered forecasts are generated solely by AI.

selection_policy: The existing core twenty nonbinary questions, not selected by outcome or new predictions.
snapshot_policy: Most recent imported saved bundle that passes exact wording, scale consistency and both-arm coordinate preservation. Rejected versions retained in zero-provider screening. Different archived capture versions across cases; identical source projection within each pair.
metadata_policy: Preserve original background and exact rules. Fill only absent archived scale/grid fields using the frozen core input after field-level consistency checks. All shared metadata and registry hashes frozen before calls.
date_policy: Three dates lack authoritative API scale/question identity; reuse prior fixed research UTC bins. Research distributions only, never claim submission validity.
evaluation_warning: Retrospective evidence and model knowledge can expose outcomes. This is an evidence-delivery engineering comparison, not a historical predictive backtest. One stochastic replicate per arm.
